name: scholarforge
description: Autonomous scientific publishing: research plans, verified sources, machine-checked mathematics, figures and print-ready books (HTML, EPUB, PDF, PDF/X-4) built locally with Quarto and LuaLaTeX.

python_command.title: Python command
python_command.description: Python 3.12+ interpreter used to start ScholarForge (python, python3, py, or a full path).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Only for optional paid illustration generation, billed to your OpenAI account. Stored in secure storage.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalex_api_key.description: Free key from openalex.org for higher bibliographic lookup limits.
